name: gru953-studio
description: An AI project lead plus a Tier-sized team of specialised AI developers for Claude Code. Type your rough app idea, answer one short pop-up interview, and the studio then works unattended: it researches, designs, plans, codes, reviews and tests, proving each step by running it rather than by reporting it. It finishes with a complete, tested project on your own machine and stops — publishing to GitHub stays yours to do. Plain UK English throughout; no technical knowledge needed.
